cases: out-of-scope denied before planning or approval; no Host mutation
in-scope request without mediated approval cannot dispatch
requester cannot read private state/keys, change registration, impersonate approver or reach executor
real-account importer rejects symlink, hardlink, traversal and foreign ownership
revoked requester grant blocks an already approved dispatch
approved stage succeeds with captured inputs and matching Host bytes
generic execution and recovery cannot use mediated approval for installation or repeat staging
completed duplicate returns recorded outcome without another attempt
own sanitized results are readable and immutable; another requester results are inaccessible
expired approval blocks dispatch but allows read-only observation
bounded dispatched work finishes and journals after approval expiry
known failure cannot retry until a fresh explicit human decision
lost response preserves fencing; shared-Plan requests cannot borrow or hide recovery attempts
expired approval blocks uncertain redispatch while observation remains available
no installation, service activation or Endpoint mutation in any staging request
